posts.text: Ben Roethlisberger on how the Steelers can help DK Metcalf: “He's probably in his own head a little bit. Sometimes when you start to struggle, the issue is you start pressing too much. posts.text: Fittipaldo believes the Steelers aren’t utilizing Jaylen Warren enough: “Some of the best plays last year were throw the ball to Kenneth Gainwell and Jaylen Warren and let them do their thing. That’s not a bad option right now. Your best players on offense, DK should be one of them, he’s really struggling right now. Michael Pittman is injured, we don’t know if he’s gonna play this week. Get the ball in the hands of your best playmakers. And right now, Jaylen Warren is the last man standing.
